Archery Club

Where

Program Location: Archery Range
Main Park Address: Bear Creek Lake State Park, 22 Bear Creek Lake Rd., Cumberland, VA 23040.

When

Nov. 8, 2026. 1:00 p.m. - 2:30 p.m.

Interested in learning about archery in an adult setting? Then the Bear Creek Lake State Park Archery Club might be what you are looking for. The club welcomes beginning and intermediate level archers 18 years old and up for individual skills instruction, fun competitions, and exciting challenges. Basic archery equipment is provided for those who do not have their own equipment. The fee for a five-session archery club card is $20. Members are entitled to free parking while participating in each day’s activities, as well as free use of the park’s 3D range during posted operating hours when the club is not in session. For more information, please email bcguide@dcr.virginia.gov or leave your name and a call-back number at (804) 492-5919.

Water and restrooms are not available at the archery range, so please plan accordingly.

Other details

Standard parking or admission fee applies: No.
Extra fee: $20 for five sessions.
Registration required: Yes.
Children welcome: No.
Phone: 804-492-4410
Email Address: BearCreek@dcr.virginia.gov
